title: Non-attacking rook placements on crossword grids
minimality_note: Conjecture 3.14 holds exhaustively for all n <= 14 (verified across all n! permutations via exact branch-and-bound, establishing r(10..14) = 255569, 3316625, 46301969, 680707985, 10353226769) and holds across all 2^(n-1) layered compositions, all J_{m1} (+) sigma (+) J_{m2} (k <= 8), and >300,000 SA/2-opt evaluations at n = 15 and n = 16.
